migration.title: Data Migration
migration.fromVersion: Your world is currently on system version:
migration.toVersion: Your world will be migrated to system version:
migration.initialHint: Please make sure none of your players are logged in to the world during migration. Also, please be sure to make a manual backup copy of the world, before beginning migration.
migration.cancelNote: Please note that you can cancel this process, but your world may not work properly with the current version of the system.
migration.error: WARNING: An error has occurred during processing.
migration.errorHint: The error should have been written to your browser's console. Make sure to copy the entire error message and submit an issue at
migration.completionHint: Please exit and save your world once to ensure the migration changes are properly saved, before continuing to use the world. After that, your world should be good to go!
migration.migrationRequiredUserWarning: It seems this world is not up to date with the installed system version. Please coordinate with your game master and log out while they migrate the world system.

autoActionPointRefill.label: Automatic AP Refilling
autoActionPointRefill.hint: If checked, action points will refill for a character at the start of every combat turn.

autoRemoveSameCombatants.label: Synchronized Combatant Removal
autoRemoveSameCombatants.hint: If checked, when removing a combatant that belongs to a character with multiple combat initiatives, will also remove the other entries of that character from the combat tracker.

enableMomentumBar.label: Enable Combat Tracker Momentum Bar
enableMomentumBar.hint: If checked, will add the Momentum tracker Bar to the combat tracker.

fancyFont.label: STRIVE Regular Font
fancyFont.hint: Toggles the 'STRIVE Regular' font off or on.

toggleDebug.label: Debug Mode
toggleDebug.hint: Toggles debug mode on - increases log verbosity, at the cost of performance.

toggleReminders.label: Reminder Hints
toggleReminders.hint: Toggles the display of rule reminders. For example, when toggled off, will no longer show the general combat actions on the character sheet and won't show the reminder to fork skills on the roll dialog.

toggleExpertiseVisibility.label: Unusable Expertise Visibility
toggleExpertiseVisibility.hint: Toggles the visibility of Expertises that are unusable (due to their owning skill's level being too low for the Expertise's requirement).
